Members

(module scope)

Preload script for the desktop launcher window. Exposes a minimal, namespaced API so the renderer can request a yarn command and receive streamed output without full node integration.

run

Request that the main process run a yarn script. Returns immediately with the process pid; output streams through onOutput.

  • @param {string} script - one of setup|dev|verify|build|desktop:dev

onOutput

Register a callback for command output lines.

  • @param {(line: string) => void} callback
